title: Weather Station
summary: Publish DHT22 temperature readings to a virtual MQTT topic.

briefing.text: Publish DHT22 temperature readings to a virtual MQTT topic.
Build the circuit, write the program, then use the live objectives and hints to check each connection.

learn.title: DHT22
learn.body:
Publish DHT22 temperature readings to a virtual MQTT topic.

Use 3V3 and GND for the sensor, DATA to GPIO23. The simulator library supplies the timing and teaching subset.

Connect to the virtual broker, publish the sensor value to weather/temperature, and inspect the topic count in the IoT tab.

objectives.text: Power the DHT22 at 3.3 V and connect DATA to GPIO23
